transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Okafor, your Signal Officer. We need to get next-day routine coordination sorted out before I publish the binding communications configuration. We have channels C1 through C4 available, with repeaters R1 covering the command area, R2 covering the clinic area, and R3 covering the logistics yard. The standard plan assigns C1 to command, C2 to logistics, C3 to clinic support, and C4 to airfield services. The signal shop can configure channels and power settings before 1800 today, so we have time to make adjustments if needed. Before I finalize and publish the configuration, I need each of you — operations, logistics, maintenance, and airfield — to report your current requirements. Let's hear what you need for tomorrow.
